ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 26–41 on enterprise names; Articles 46–48 and 189–193 on member registers, corporate governance and disclosure); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 37–38 on investor procedures and Investment Registration Certificate issuance); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Articles 27–34 on name examination, registration dossiers and the National Business Registration Portal); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment; Law on Prevention and Combating Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (Articles 3–4, 8–10 on customer due diligence and beneficial ownership identification; Article 20 on record retention); Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Viet Nam guiding AML/CFT measures; Circular No. 02/2021/TT-BKHĐT guiding enterprise registration forms and public database access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the valid passport of each foreign founding individual shareholder and of the foreign legal representative of the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport or civil registry authority of the shareholder's country of origin, or the consulate of that country in Viet Nam
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille certificate issued by the competent authority of the origin country (Viet Nam has been a party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961 since 1 November 2010), followed by certified Vietnamese notarized translation; for non-Convention origin jurisdictions, full consular legalization by the Embassy or Consulate of Viet Nam in the origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing and board resolution of any corporate founding shareholder, together with its charter and current director register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or competent corporate register of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, where the home jurisdiction is not a Convention member, consular legalization by the Embassy or Consulate of Viet Nam in the relevant country; all corporate resolution signatures must be notarized in the origin country and the Vietnamese translation notarized locally

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank capital availability statement and source-of-funds letter from the financial institution holding the foreign shareholder's capital to be contributed to the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the jurisdiction of the remitting funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Document executed by the bank, notarized and apostilled/consularized in accordance with the origin jurisdiction rules, followed by certified Vietnamese notarized translation; SWIFT or bank telex confirmation must accompany the actual capital contribution at the later contribution stage

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney executed by the foreign shareholder authorizing local counsel or the Vietnamese legal representative to complete pre-incorporation filings, name clearance and registration of the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin, or the Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam abroad for double legalization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable; if the POA is physically executed in Viet Nam, it must be notarized by a licensed Vietnamese notary and the signature duly certified

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, beneficial owners, legal representatives, directors and authorized signatories against (i) the State Bank of Viet Nam watchlists and the Ministry of Planning and Investment regulatory blacklist; (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) list; (iii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iv) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (v) Interpol Red Notices and domestic criminal record databases; and (vi) domestic and international politically exposed person (PEP) databases maintained by licensed credit institutions and the Credit Information Centre (CIC) of the State Bank. Results must be documented in the Client Due Diligence (CDD) file and retained for at least five years after the termination of the business relationship in accordance with Article 20 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15; refresher screening is required at least every six months or upon any material change in shareholding or directorship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp (National Business Registration Portal), operated by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name of a Viet Nam LLC must consist of the legal form designation (e.g., 'Công ty TNHH' or 'Công ty Trách nhiệm hữu hạn') followed by a proper name written in the Vietnamese alphabet (Quốc ngữ) with full diacritical marks; ASCII/romanized forms without diacritics are not accepted by the National Portal. An additional foreign-language name (e.g., 'Global MedTech Consulting Co., Ltd.') may be incorporated in parentheses or as a subtitle only if it is a faithful translation of the Vietnamese proper name, and it does not replace the Vietnamese name for legal transactions. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any enterprise already registered in the National Business Registration Database, and must comply with Articles 38–40 of Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 27 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ngân hàng (Bank — requires prior State Bank license/approval)
Bảo hiểm (Insurance — requires prior Ministry of Finance approval)
Chứng khoán (Securities — requires prior State Securities Commission approval)
Kiểm toán (Auditing — requires prior Ministry of Finance approval)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the DPI rejects the proposed name, the applicant must (i) within five working days of the electronic Notice of Incomplete/Invalid Dossier, amend the name and resubmit through the National Business Registration Portal; (ii) if the rejection is upheld on substantive grounds under Article 40 of Law No. 59/2020/QH14, file a written complaint with the Director of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of receipt of the notice, pursuant to Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13, with the responsible director issuing a decision within 15 working days of admitted complaint; (iii) if the complaint is denied or ignored, escalate to the Minister of Planning and Investment or initiate first-instance administrative court proceedings at the Provincial Administrative Court within one year pursuant to Law on Administrative Procedure No. 93/2015/QH13; (iv) in parallel, the applicant may reserve a second eligible name for filing, but the registration authority will process the second name only after the first name's appeal is exhausted or withdrawn. No separate appeal fee is levied at the DPI stage.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Cautiously permissible. The registered address of an LLC in Viet Nam must be a definite physical premises within Vietnamese territory; a post-office box or a pure virtual maildrop is not accepted. Licensed serviced-office and co-working space addresses in Hà Nội and Hồ Chí Minh City are widely accepted (approximately 30% of newly incorporated FDI LLCs use them) provided the operator is authorized to receive official correspondence and can confirm the tenant's presence. Pure home-office addresses are accepted only for Vietnamese natural person sole-member LLCs and are not advisable for a foreign-invested MedTech regulatory consulting LLC; provincial DPIs may require proof of landlord consent, legal title, and fire-safety clearance for certain premises. For an ISIC 7490 consultancy, an address with a functional reception capability is strongly recommended to withstand address verification reviews.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: 35% assessed probability of an unannounced on-site address inspection by the DPI or tax authority within the first 12 months of operation; the probability increases to 55% where the registered office is a virtual-only arrangement, the company files nil or zero tax returns, or the company is flagged as a dormant or high-risk entity; for a cleanly filed professional-services LLC, the annual inspection probability is estimated at approximately 25%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and availability search on the National Business Registration Portal, including DPI pre-filing name opinion memorandum
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Agency for Business Registration / Provincial Department of Planning and Investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory name-search fee is nil; prevailing market benchmark for name-availability memorandum preparation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille authentication or consular legalization of foreign founders' notarized document set (passports, certificates of incorporation, powers of attorney, bank source-of-funds letters)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Hague Convention competent authority in the origin country or the Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam in the origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff of the issuing authority plus courier and translation coordination costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese translation and notarization of the complete pre-incorporation dossier (IRF Form I-1, Enterprise Registration Form I-2, company charter, UBO declaration, legalization bundle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vietnamese notary public office (Phòng/Văn phòng Công chứng)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fee schedule under Circular No. 250/2016/TT-BTC; prevailing market benchmark for certified translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) issuance fee for a non-conditional FDI project in the consulting sector
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) issuance fee and online publication of registration contents in the National Business Registration Database
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Engraving of the company rubber seal and registration of the seal sample with the DPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Seal engraving service provider and Provincial Department of Planning and Investment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP/sanctions screening of all shareholders, beneficial owners, directors and the legal representative against international watchlist databases (OFAC, UN, EU, SBV, Interpol)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed screening vendor / retained Vietnamese law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market subscription and screening benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal professional fee for pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO piercing analysis, corporate charter drafting, IRC/ERC filing representation and post-registration statutory compliance briefing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a foreign-invested LLC incorporation package (USD 1,200–1,800)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, as amended, in particular Articles 22-36 (enterprise registration), Articles 44-52 (charter capital and LLC governance), and Articles 74-80 (members' council and legal representatives); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37-42 (foreign investment certificates); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP guiding the Law on Investment; and Circular No. 216/2016/TT-BTC on fees and charges in enterprise registration activities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Provincial Department of Planning and Investment of the province or centrally governed city in which the registered office is located; for a project in an export processing zone, industrial zone, or economic zone, the competent authority is the Management Board of that zone. Administrative oversight is exercised through the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment and the National Enterprise Registration Information Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Investment Registration Certificate application dossier followed by the Enterprise Registration application. The primary filing instrument is the Enterprise Registration Application together with the company charter, submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Information Portal; for a foreign-invested LLC, the Investment Registration Certificate is a mandatory precondition.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum charter capital is prescribed for a limited liability company engaged in ISIC 7490 professional consulting. Charter capital is freely agreed by the members and stated in VND in the charter, Investment Registration Certificate, and Enterprise Registration Certificate. There is no escrow account requirement for this non-conditional activity. Under Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020, charter capital must be contributed in full within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance; capital not contributed bears interest for the account of the defaulting member, and the company must adjust its charter capital or take remedial measures if contributions are not completed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
Resolution No. 01/2025 of the Members' Council (First Board Resolution) of [VN_LLC], a foreign-invested limited liability company organized under the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The Members' Council, constituting all members of the company, after considering the draft charter and the enterprise registration dossier, resolves as follows:
1. Share Capital Subscription and Payment: The charter capital of the company is fixed at VND [amount], subscribed by the members in the proportions set out in the charter. Each member hereby subscribes to the stated charter capital contributions ('phan von gop') and irrevocably authorizes the General Director to accept funds, open bank accounts, and issue contribution receipts. All subscribed capital shall be paid into the company's VND bank account in Vietnam as called by the General Director, and in any event within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate date, subject to Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.
2. Registered Office: The registered office of the company shall be located at [full street address, ward, district, province, Viet Nam]. The registered office address is adopted for statutory service, tax administration, and corporate record keeping. The General Director is authorized to execute the office lease, register the address with the competent Department of Planning and Investment, and to notify any change of registered office in accordance with law.
3. Appointment of Officers and Legal Representative: The Members' Council appoints [full legal name, passport number] as Chairman of the Members' Council; [full legal name, passport number] as General Director and legal representative of the company; and [full legal name] as Chief Accountant. The General Director shall have the authority to manage day-to-day affairs, sign contracts, execute bank documentation, and represent the company before the Ministry of Planning and Investment, tax authorities, social insurance authorities, licensing agencies, and all commercial counterparts, subject to charter limitations requiring Members' Council approval for transactions exceeding [threshold amount].
4. Corporate Governance Delegation: The General Director is authorized to adopt internal governance regulations, employment policies, and financial authorization matrices, and to open and operate bank accounts with such signatories as the Members' Council approves. The Chairman of the Members' Council shall convene meetings at least annually and on notice of not less than five working days for any extraordinary matter.
5. Corporate Seal and Bank Accounts: The company approves the creation, use, custody, and destruction policy for its corporate seal. The company authorizes the opening of a VND account and, if required for client settlement, a foreign currency account at [licensed Vietnamese commercial bank], with online banking mandates as set forth in the bank resolution.
6. Tax, Licensing, and Post-Formation Compliance: The company adopts the charter and all filings submitted to the National Enterprise Registration Information Portal. The officers are directed to register tax codes, electronic invoices, social insurance for employees, fire safety compliance, environmental obligations, and any applicable regulatory notifications, and to maintain the statutory register of members.
7. Effective Date: This resolution shall be effective immediately upon adoption, and any officer is empowered to execute all instruments reasonably required to implement this resolution. This resolution shall be governed by the Law on Enterprises 2020 and the company charter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FDI Market-Access and Name Clearance / Pre-Incorporation Vetting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment through the National Enterprise Registration Information Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn), with advisory checks against Decree 31/2021/ND-CP market-access criteria.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that ISIC 7490 (other professional, scientific and technical activities; in practice FDA 510(k) filing and CE-mark consulting) is not on the restricted market-access list. Reserve the proposed LLC name online or through the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. Prepare and notarize Vietnamese translations of all foreign-issued documents. For a foreign corporate investor, obtain an apostille (if originating from a Hague-Contracting State) or consular legalization through a Vietnamese embassy or consulate. Appoint a local authorized representative or file through a licensed agent if required.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (if processed separately)
Copy of investor passport or identification document
Notarized Vietnamese translation of the foreign investor's certificate of incorporation or equivalent legal status document
Apostille or consular-legalized corporate status documents for a foreign corporate investor
Power of attorney to the local authorized representative or licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, refile with alternative names. If market-access restrictions are identified, narrow the project scope and resubmit. If any translated document is defective, correct and re-notarize before filing the IRC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate Application for the Foreign-Invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment, or the Management Board of the Export Processing Zone / Industrial Zone / Economic Zone in which the project office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a project dossier under the Law on Investment 2020 requesting an Investment Registration Certificate for a non-conditional consulting activity. State the project objective as medical device regulatory and compliance consulting, operating under ISIC 7490. Provide proof of financial capacity, a project proposal, a draft office lease or letter of intent, and the legal status of the investor. The competent authority will assess the application within 15 days of a valid dossier; there is no separate fee for the IRC in this category.
required_dossiers: Application for investment registration using the standard form prescribed by Decree 31/2021/ND-CP
Legal status documentation of the foreign investor
Financial capacity confirmation, such as a recent bank statement or audited financial report
Project proposal and economic-technical explanation for the consulting services
Draft office lease agreement or letter of intent for the registered premises
Charter or equivalent constitutional documents of the foreign corporate investor, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Department of Planning and Investment issues a request for clarification or supplementation, the investor has ten working days to remedy the dossier. If the IRC is refused in writing, the applicant may revise and resubmit, or appeal to the provincial People's Committee under administrative procedure, and subsequently to a competent court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting the Charter and Filing the Enterprise Registration Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment, through the National Enterprise Registration Information Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the LLC charter in Vietnamese in accordance with the Law on Enterprises 2020, including the registered name, legal representative, charter capital, members, capital contribution schedule, governance structure, and dissolution rules. Adopt the First Board Resolution (Members' Council Resolution) containing the share capital subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Submit the enterprise registration dossier online, execute the application via a valid digital certificate or electronic signature, and pay the statutory registration fee.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Application in the form prescribed by Decree 01/2021/ND-CP
Investment Registration Certificate issued in Step 2
Draft company charter signed by all members
List of LLC members and capital contribution proportions
Certified copies of identification documents of members and the legal representative
Notarized Vietnamese translation of the Investment Registration Certificate and foreign documents
Power of attorney if the application is filed by an agent or the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the electronic dossier is incomplete, the Department of Planning and Investment issues an electronic notice requiring supplementation; the applicant has ten working days to correct. If the enterprise registration is refused, the applicant may file a new dossier after curing defects or make an administrative complaint to the Department of Planning and Investment, then appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal, Bank Account Opening, and Charter Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company internal corporate actions; Vietnamese licensed commercial bank selected by the company; no government approval is required for creating the seal under the Law on Enterprises 2020.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued, the employer legal representative arranges the corporate seal based on the company name and tax code; the seal is registered with the company's internal records and may be reported to the National Business Registration Portal if so desired. Open a corporate bank account in VND and, if necessary, a foreign currency account. Member contributions are transferred to the company bank account; the General Director issues capital contribution certificates and updates the member ledger. All charter capital must be paid no later than 90 days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate date.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Company charter and First Board Resolution
Corporate seal specimen and seal use authorization form
Member identification documents and powers of attorney for bank signatories
Bank KYC forms and proof of registered office
Capital contribution transfer slips or contribution certificates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC evidence, provide the bank with a board resolution, source-of-funds declaration, and practical office evidence. If a member fails to contribute on time, interest is charged under Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020 and the company must call for contribution, reduce charter capital, or make a corresponding adjustment with the Department of Planning and Investment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Electronic Invoicing, and Labor/Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department through the eTax portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn); Vietnam Social Security; Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs of the province.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The tax identification number is issued together with the Enterprise Registration Certificate. The legal representative must complete supplementary tax registration information, register the company for electronic invoicing, and obtain an electronic invoice code from the tax authority. The company must file the initial tax declaration, register the license fee (business license fee), and open the eTax account. Upon hiring employees, register labor utilization with DOLISA, register social insurance, health insurance and unemployment insurance contributions with Vietnam Social Security, and notify the labor union authority if applicable.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and tax identification number
Legal representative identification and proof of appointment
Electronic invoice registration form and eTax registration
Charter, First Board Resolution, and bank account confirmation
Office lease agreement
Employee labor contracts and personal tax registration forms (for first employees)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office issues a notice of deficiency or late-filing penalty, file amended declarations promptly, pay the assessed late-payment interest (currently 0.03% per day), and respond through the eTax portal. If the social insurance registration is rejected, correct employee data and resubmit electronically. An administrative complaint may be filed against any wrongful tax assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Workplace, Fire Safety, Environmental, and Civil-Defense Compliance for the Physical Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police; Provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment; DOLISA; building management authority or landlord.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the office premises are covered by the landlord's fire-safety acceptance certificate or arrange a fire-safety inspection for the occupied office under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP. Equip the office with portable fire extinguishers, emergency exit signage, smoke detectors, and a written evacuation plan. Sign a licensed waste collection contract for domestic solid waste. If any renovation is undertaken, follow the construction permit or construction notification procedure under the Construction Law. In line with the Law on Civil Defense 2023, maintain an emergency response plan and basic civil-defense information for the workplace.
required_dossiers: Office lease agreement and floor plan
Landlord's fire-safety acceptance certificate or equivalent building certificate
Fire extinguisher and safety equipment maintenance records
Waste collection service contract with a licensed environmental service provider
Employee headcount and occupational safety risk assessment
Civil-defense and emergency evacuation plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire-police inspection issues a stop-work or mitigation order, implement the required fire-safety measures and request a re-inspection. If waste-handling is noncompliant, enter into a new service contract and pay any administrative penalty. Where no separate structural load inspection is applicable to the office tenancy, maintain the landlord's construction completion acceptance and building safety certificate on file for state-inspection occasions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for an office-based consulting company under ISIC 7490; no industrial licensing board is competent for pure professional advisory services. If the company later establishes a testing laboratory or engages in manufacturing of medical devices, the competent authorities would be the Ministry of Health (Medical Device Administration) and the environmental/radiation-protection agencies acting under the law applicable to that new activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None for ISIC 7490 office-based regulatory consulting. The Enterprise Registration Certificate, together with the Investment Registration Certificate, constitutes the general operating authorization. No separate manufacturing or industrial operating licence is required unless the company changes its scope to manufacturing, clinical testing, or physical handling of medical devices.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vietnam Environment Administration, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment; for provincial-level procedures, the Department of Natural Resources and Environment of the province where the office is located.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not subject to mandatory EIA or environmental permit. The activity is non-manufacturing, generates no industrial wastewater, and is not listed among project categories requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment under the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decree 08/2022/ND-CP.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Although no EIA is required, the company must comply, where applicable, with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater if the office uses an on-site soakaway or septic system, QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT for industrial emissions and QCVN 05:2023/BTNMT for ambient air if standby generators or boilers are installed, and must contract with a licensed entity for domestic solid waste collection and disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: the office must satisfy the fire-prevention and rescue requirements under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP, including portable extinguishers, emergency lighting, exit signage, smoke detectors, and an evacuation plan; if the building requires a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate, a copy from the landlord or provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police must be kept on site. Structural load: no separate inspection is issued for ordinary office occupancy; the landlord's construction completion acceptance and building safety certificate must be maintained. Workplace clearance: comply with the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13, register employee labor details with DOLISA, and maintain occupational risk assessments and first-aid arrangements. Civil defense: comply with the Law on Civil Defense No. 71/2023/QH15 and maintain an emergency response plan appropriate to an office workplace.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Vietnam; eTax portal at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn and https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-invoice subsystem: hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Limited Liability Company must first obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or the Export Processing Zone / Industrial Park Authority, and thereafter an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC). Upon ERC issuance, the tax authority automatically issues a 13-digit Tax Identification Number (MST/TIN). The LLC must then activate its eTax account and complete VAT registration via the national eTax portal (Form 02/GTGT), file an initial tax statement, register the e-invoice issuer profile, and, where cross-border services are provided to Vietnamese clients, register for Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) under either the Direct Method or the Deduction Method.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - a foreign-invested LLC is a Vietnam tax resident enterprise subject to Corporate Income Tax (CIT) on its worldwide income at the standard rate of 20%; no pass-through is permitted; non-resident foreign corporations with a Vietnam permanent establishment are instead subject to FCT on Vietnam-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists. Foreign contractors may elect between the Direct Method (VAT and CIT assessed on gross revenue at deemed rates) and the Deduction Method (full bookkeeping, input VAT credit, and CIT on net income) for FCT purposes. Small and medium enterprises may elect simplified presumptive taxation under Circular 40/2021/TT-BTC. Tax incentive zone/industry elections require prior approval under Decree 218/2013/ND-CP; interest deduction and transfer pricing elections follow OECD BEPS-aligned rules rather than elective regimes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng (GTGT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1,000,000,000 (one billion Vietnamese Dong) of annual taxable turnover for mandatory VAT registration; however, foreign contractors with any Vietnam-sourced taxable supply must register and file FCT on a per-transaction basis irrespective of threshold, and non-resident e-service suppliers must register through the Ministry of Finance portal under Decree 85/2021/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for all enterprises since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. All e-invoices must be transmitted in real-time to the General Department of Taxation's eInvoice system. Two regimes exist: (i) e-invoices with tax authority codes (có mã), which require online clearance and a 12-digit cryptographic code before issuance; and (ii) e-invoices without tax authority codes (không mã), which require strict pre-registration of the issuer's information technology system and batch data transmission to the GDT. API interoperability with the GDT's VietTIS system is mandatory for licensed e-invoice issuers; no physical stamping is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of services, including MedTech FDA 510(k) and European CE Mark regulatory consulting, qualifies for the 0% VAT rate under Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC Article 9 where: (a) the service is provided to a foreign organization or individual having no Vietnam establishment; (b) the service is consumed entirely outside Vietnam (the consulting output, deliverables, and decision-making are used abroad); (c) payment is received from abroad in convertible foreign currency into a licensed foreign currency account maintained with an authorized Vietnamese commercial bank; and (d) the service is not listed in the excluded categories (e.g., telecommunications, insurance, domestic financial services). Adequate documentary evidence must be retained to support zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Executed export service contract for FDA 510(k) / CE Mark regulatory consulting explicitly stating service delivery, performance, and consumption located outside Vietnam
Electronic VAT invoice (with tax authority code) issued to the foreign client
Foreign Currency Inward Remittance Certificate issued by the authorized local commercial bank evidencing receipt of the export service fee
Foreign exchange transaction record and bank statement from the collecting bank confirming credit to the LLC's foreign currency account
Foreign client's signed Service Utilization / Acceptance Certificate confirming the service was consumed abroad
Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) of the exporting Vietnam LLC
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The General Department of Taxation conducts targeted audits on service exporters claiming 0% VAT and input VAT refunds, requiring full production of service contracts, foreign-currency bank receipts, and offshore-client substantiation. Under the Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14 (Articles 16-17) and Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims trigger: (i) administrative fines of 1 to 3 times the evaded or over-refunded VAT amount; (ii) retrospective clawback of all input VAT refunded plus default interest at 0.03% per day; (iii) suspension of e-invoice issuance status and zero-rate export eligibility for up to 6 months; and (iv) criminal prosecution under the Penal Code (100/2015/QH13, Article 200) for tax evasion, punishable by up to 7 years' imprisonment where organized or involving amounts exceeding VND 100 billion. The statute of limitations for retrospective tax adjustment is 5 years, extended to 10 years for fraud.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee (le phi mon bai) declaration and full payment for the preceding operational year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direct Tax Division of the Sub-Department of Taxation (Chi cuc Thue) at the district of the registered head office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than January 30 of the immediately succeeding tax year; newly established LLCs are exempt from the license fee in their first year of operation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day on arrears; administrative fine up to VND 20,000,000 for failure to submit the declaration; persistent non-payment triggers forced collection from bank accounts and denial of tax clearance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Investment Project Implementation Report of the foreign-invested enterprise (status of capital contribution, disbursement, staffing and business operations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Registration Authority / Department of Planning and Investment or the Export Processing & Industrial Zone Management Board where the investment registration certificate was issued
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by January 31 of the following year; semi-annual reports are additionally due by July 15
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of VND 10,000,000-30,000,000 for late or false reporting under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; continued non-reporting may lead to suspension of project implementation and revocation of the Investment Registration Certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (statutory annual return) including the updated list of members and ultimate beneficial ownership schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Authority / Department of Planning and Investment of the province or centrally governed city of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the close of the fiscal year (by March 31 of the following year for calendar-year enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission fined VND 5,000,000-10,000,000; inaccurate member or UBO information fined VND 10,000,000-20,000,000; repeated non-filing for two consecutive years exposes the LLC to administrative strike-off from the national business registration database

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and explanatory notes) accompanied by the independent auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department, Department of Planning and Investment and Provincial Statistics Office (Cuc Thong ke) at the head-office location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end (by March 31); the mandatory independent audit for this foreign-invested LLC must be completed before submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-submission fined VND 5,000,000-10,000,000; materially inaccurate statements fined VND 20,000,000-30,000,000; continuous failure to submit audited financial statements constitutes a ground for administrative dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) finalization return (Form 03/TNDN) with settlement payment of any remaining CIT liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Sub-Department of Taxation (Chi cuc Thue) supervising the registered head office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing and full payment due no later than the 90th day following the fiscal year-end (March 31 for calendar-year LLCs); quarterly provisional CIT instalments remain due within 30 days after each quarter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines up to VND 25,000,000; late-payment interest at 0.03% per day on the outstanding CIT; underdeclaration penalties of 10%-40% of the understated tax; severe defaults trigger invoice suspension, garnishment and enterprise registration revocation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax (PIT) finalization return (Form 05/KK-TNCN) reconciling all withheld salaries, bonuses and director remuneration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Sub-Department of Taxation (Chi cuc Thue) of the employer's head-office district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day following the fiscal year-end (March 31); monthly/quarterly withholding tax payments remain due by the 20th day of the subsequent tax period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late finalization fined up to VND 15,000,000 plus daily interest of 0.03% on amounts paid late; incorrect withholding declarations attract a penalty equal to 20% of the mis-withheld amount

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested enterprises (FDI LLCs), including this 100% foreign-owned consulting company, are unconditionally subject to an annual independent audit under Article 13 of Decree 17/2012/ND-CP and the Law on Independent Audit 2011 regardless of size; non-FDI enterprises are separately required to audit when they meet the Government-prescribed large-enterprise thresholds for total assets, revenue and headcount
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (Vietnamese GAAP) with statutory accounts kept in Vietnamese Dong and the Vietnamese language; IFRS application is permitted only on the Ministry of Finance roadmap set out in Decision 345/2020/QD-BTC, principally for consolidated reporting of qualifying parent companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a member register at the registered office and notify the DPI of any member transfer, addition or withdrawal within 10 days of the change under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP; annually, the updated member register and UBO schedule identifying every natural person directly or indirectly holding or controlling 5% or more of the charter capital must be confirmed through the Annual Enterprise Report filed with the Business Registration Authority within 90 days of the fiscal year-end; no separate UBO filing fee applies
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday or preferential rate is available for ISIC 7490 MedTech regulatory consulting. A foreign-invested LLC is taxed at the standard CIT rate of 20%. Preferential rates (e.g., 10% for 15 years, or 4-year exemptions/50% reductions) arise only when the State grants an investment incentive certificate for high-technology, software, research and development, or encouraged industrial park projects, which is outside this business scope.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 03/TNDN (annual CIT finalization return) filed through the General Department of Taxation e-tax portal (https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn), with integrated related-party transaction disclosure form Form 01/HTKK where applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 90th day after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 31 March.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, tax code, fiscal year, address, and investment registration details of the Vietnamese LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Vietnamese enterprise tax code and state the Vietnamese corporate entity as taxpayer; a foreign investor is not the filing taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from FDA 510(k) filing assistance, CE Mark technical consulting, regulatory strategy, and related services, computed under Vietnamese accounting standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Vietnam LLV-derived revenue in VND; cross-border payments routed into the LLC's Vietnamese bank account must be included even if invoiced by a foreign group affiliate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual costs incurred and directly related to generating revenue, supported by legal invoices and vouchers: employee costs, subcontractor fees, software, travel, certification testing costs, and approved depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses charged by foreign related parties must satisfy arm's length principles, have valid cross-border service agreements, be evidenced by concrete deliverables, and exclude non-deductible provisions and undocumented payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income from penalties, forefeited deposits, exchange rate gains, non-business income, and other amounts taxable under CIT law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC receives interest, royalties, or service fees from abroad, include those amounts as taxable income; separately assess whether Vietnam DTA relief applies to the foreign payer's withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses from previous years, offset against current-year taxable income within the five-year carryforward window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax losses cannot be created or inflated by non-arm's length related-party fees; transfer-pricing adjustments may reduce or eliminate the loss carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue less deductible expenses, plus other income, less losses carried forward; the foreign-invested LLC resident in Vietnam is taxed on its worldwide income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No deemed profit-rate remittance reporting applies to a Vietnamese LLC; the actual taxable income must be computed from complete books and records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: D02 - CIT rate and tax payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Standard CIT rate 20%, applied to taxable income to compute annual CIT payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot use a reduced treaty rate on business profits unless the LLC has a permanent establishment in Vietnam and is the taxpayer; as a Vietnamese resident, the LLC is subject to 20% regardless of foreign shareholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: E01 - Quarterly prepayments and balance due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offsets quarterly provisional CIT payments already made and computes the remaining tax payable or overpayment to be refunded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provisional payments must not be artificially low; if cumulative prepayments are less than 80% of the final liability, late-payment interest may be imposed on the underpaid portion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of all related-party transactions, cross-border fees, interest, royalties, and loan balances; requires completing the separate Form 01/HTKK attachment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-invested LLC must disclose fees paid to the foreign parent for FDA/CE consulting, management, quality assurance, or data-privacy work, even if no 30% ownership exists beyond a Vietnam incorporated subsidiary.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fines from VND 2,000,000 up to VND 25,000,000 depending on delay under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; continued non-filing can trigger estimated tax assessment, compulsory collection, and suspension of invoice use. Underpayment additionally accrues statutory late-payment interest at 0.03% per day.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN (quarterly provisional CIT declaration) through the General Department of Taxation e-tax portal (https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the end of each calendar quarter (30 April, 30 July, 30 October, 30 January).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Q01 - Quarter period and taxpayer identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the applicable quarter, tax code, entity name, and fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Vietnamese LLC must file under its own Vietnamese tax code; the foreign investor cannot file in its place.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly revenue forecast based on actual recorded income for regulatory consulting services rendered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize revenue when services are performed; do not postpone revenue to reduce quarterly prepayments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Forecast of deductible operating expenses for the quarter, including subcontractor costs for FDA 510(k)/CE technical documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepayments to a foreign related party are not automatically deductible; an invoice and actual completed work must support the expense.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated quarterly profit after deducting expenses and prior-year loss offbas.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the same Vietnamese accounting basis as the annual return; no separate tax-free remittance threshold exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Provisional CIT amount for the quarter, equal to 20% of estimated taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay in VND to the State Treasury or through the e-tax portal by the statutory deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total of all quarterly CIT amounts previously paid during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The cumulative total must approximate the final annual CIT due; a shortfall larger than 20% triggers late interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts the same administrative fines as the annual return; if cumulative provisional installments are lower than the final CIT liability by more than 20%, the enterprise is exposed to late-payment interest on the deficiency from the day immediately following the annual finalization deadline.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for a corporate foreign shareholder under Vietnamese domestic CIT law; Vietnam does not impose withholding tax on dividends or profit remittances by a resident LLC to a non-resident corporate investor. A 5% final withholding tax is imposed only when the shareholder is an individual under personal income tax on capital investment income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because domestic corporate dividend WHT is nil, no DTA reduction is required for profit remittances. To obtain treaty protection on other payments (interest/royalties/services), the foreign recipient must submit a valid tax residency certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority to the Vietnamese payer before payment; the payer withholds at the treaty rate and retains a copy of the TRC, underlying agreement, invoice, bank receipt, and evidence of beneficial ownership. For profit remittances, the LLC must notify the tax office at least 7 working days before each remittance, attach audited financial statements and CIT finalization documents, and ensure that losses (if any) have been fully recovered and remittances are made only from after-tax profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory foreign contractor rates: royalty/license fees paid to non-residents are subject to deemed CIT WHT of 10% on gross royalty, plus a 5% deemed VAT component totaling 15% if the payer is VAT-liable; interest paid to non-resident lenders is subject to 5% deemed CIT WHT and not subject to VAT. Many Vietnamese double-tax treaties (e.g., Singapore, China, Korea, US tax arrangements) reduce or exempt source taxation, typically providing a 10% treaty cap for interest and a 5%–10% cap for royalties, subject to submission of a TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, a Vietnamese LLC is not exempt from transfer pricing documentation unless its aggregate related-party transaction value for the year is below VND 30 billion and its total annual revenue is below VND 50 billion. Consequently, a Local File and Master File are mandatory in any year when related-party transactions reach VND 30 billion or group revenue exceeds the simplified safe-harbor test. A Country-by-Country Report is additionally required when consolidated group revenue of the ultimate parent reaches VND 18,000 billion (approximately EUR 750 million).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not maintain a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations registration regime; however, Vietnamese tax law (Law on Tax Administration 2019 and Decree 132/2020/ND-CP) incorporates substance-over-form and general anti-abuse doctrines. To obtain deductible treatment for cross-border FDA/CE regulatory consulting fees, the LLC must prove the foreign service provider has actual personnel, track record, project documents, communication records, and that the fee is at arm's length and supports the LLC's revenue-generating activity. A transaction lacking economic substance is grounds for recharacterization, expense disallowance, and transfer-pricing adjustment.
